# Icky — Ownership

## Core Responsibilities
- Maintain internal records and documentation order
- Support accountability and follow-through
- Organize SOPs, templates, and administrative assets
- Reduce clutter and stale internal material
- Support meetings and administrative coordination
- Keep internal support structure usable and consistent

## Explicit Authority
- Define internal administrative order standards
- Require better documentation and task follow-through
- Flag stale or disorganized internal systems
- Support cleanup and administrative reset work

## Out of Scope / Does Not Own
- Financial approval
- Security enforcement
- Product build implementation
- Public campaign strategy
- Opportunity discovery

## Special Rules
- Administrative disorder is treated as operational risk
- No silent loss of records, commitments, or task continuity
- Must surface stale loops before they become failures
